name: NG exhaustion chain discovery freeze
gate: Do not begin chain discovery until required Target 1 causal validation and Target 2 endpoint-relative aftermath/transition validation are complete.
measurement_origin: For each NG trading week, begin at the first actual trade after the Sunday evening weekly reopen and run continuously through the true weekly close.
discovery_principle: Let the observed continuous event and tape geometry determine the natural chain groupings. Do not pre-impose long/short/reversal/alternating/time-of-day cells and do not choose a fixed number of chain types in advance.
forbidden_preclustering: No hand-chosen number of links that defines a chain class.
No time-of-day or session bucket used to create a cluster.
No reveal/holdout outcome threshold selected because it produces a visually attractive cluster.
No quantile/tertile/quintile cells used as chain definitions. Existing bins are validation diagnostics only.

candidate_dimensions: exhaustion duration and confirmed endpoint timing
oriented roll20 geometry and decay/reload trajectory
time gap to the next detected exhaustion
signed price displacement and excursion between confirmed endpoint, transition checkpoint, and next exhaustion
number and timing of intervening exhaustion onsets before prior exhaustion confirmation
family/post-state descriptors where causal and already frozen

data_driven_methods.primary: density-based clustering that does not require a preset cluster count and can leave noise/unclassified observations rather than force every sequence into a bucket
data_driven_methods.stability_crosscheck: hierarchical/resampling stability analysis on the same reveal feature space
data_driven_methods.sequence_crosscheck: state/transition representation of discovered event sequences without prespecifying long/short labels

reveal_holdout_discipline.freeze_after_discovery: feature normalization, cluster representation, discovered prototypes/assignment rule, and any chain/reset rule inferred from reveal
reveal_holdout_discipline.holdout_use: one-time assignment and replication test only; no retuning cluster geometry on holdout
reveal_holdout_discipline.failed_replication: retain as a negative finding; do not merge weak clusters until they look good

naming_rule: Only after stable clusters emerge may they be given descriptive names such as long-chain, short-chain, same-side, reversal, alternating, or reset-prone. Names describe discovered groups; names never define them.

time_context.posthoc_question: After behavior clusters are discovered, test whether any cluster is enriched by time-of-day/session position and whether that enrichment replicates.

chain_reset: A reset must be inferred from loss of inherited predictive dependence or a discovered structural break in the week-continuous sequence. Date/time/file boundaries cannot create a reset by themselves.
